notes: Cleaner menu, every tool still there: 13 buttons instead of 19
NEW Specs + tune-up: finds free speed your PC isn't using (monitor Hz, RAM speed, Game Bar recording, mouse acceleration and more). Full does each one with one key - U puts it back
Network: live ping and speed test in one place - and if a faster DNS exists, it asks 'switch?'
Screen Director: an on/off switch and a brightness slider under every monitor (your main screen always stays on)
Screen Director: switch between headset and speakers with a click - or your own hotkey, even in a game
System monitor: pick an app in the process list and press E to end it (Full)
Game boost: a READY? check on top - ping, CPU, RAM, free space and updates at a glance
Restore point: press R as Purge opens - it makes one first, then cleans
Uninstaller: Steam games now uninstall through Steam itself
Premium: you set the name in your logo once. Typo? Open a ticket for a one-time fix
Ambient mode fixes, and menu descriptions that always fit
